lines.zh: 我四条腿走着，颈上的壳在晃。
lines.en: I walk on four legs, the shell on my neck swaying.

lines.zh: 嘴里含着海水，我不敢咽。
lines.en: My mouth is full of seawater. I don't dare swallow.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，留下一路湿痕。
lines.en: My trail is a wet track behind me.
My neck is so long that lowering my head is a chore.

lines.zh: 我走得比羊驼慢，也更沉。
lines.en: I walk slower than a llama, and heavier.

lines.zh: 背上的毛，一缕一缕粘着。
lines.en: The wool on my back mats in wet strands.
I cross the shallows with water at my hooves.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子喷气，喷出水雾。
lines.en: I snort and a mist of water sprays out.

lines.zh: 我绕过渔网，那东西缠人。
lines.en: I walk around the fishing nets; they tangle.
I head for the village, looking for llamas.
My hooves go soft in the water.

lines.zh: 四个影子在水面上拖得很长。
lines.en: Four long shadows drag across the water.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，走得像在权衡。
lines.en: Step by step, as if weighing each one.

lines.zh: 风从海上吹来，我停了停。
lines.en: The wind comes off the sea and I pause.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵转了转，听到潮声。
lines.en: My ears turn; I hear the tide.
Along the shore, I shuffle slowly.

lines.zh: 我站着，颈上的壳咔了一下。
lines.en: I stand and the shell at my neck clicks.

lines.zh: 我在嚼，可嘴里都是咸的。
lines.en: I'm chewing, and it's all salt.

lines.zh: 尾巴不动，我不像本来的我。
lines.en: My tail doesn't move. I'm not what I was.

lines.zh: 我抬头发呆，脖子显得更长。
lines.en: Head raised, my neck looks even longer.
Water runs down my back.
I see seabirds and want to spit at them.

lines.zh: 我的毛里长了点别的东西。
lines.en: Something else is growing in my wool.

lines.zh: 我听见远处的浪，一下一下。
lines.en: I hear the distant surf, beat after beat.
The sand under me slowly sinks.
I have no herd, and I'm not looking.
I turn my head slowly and the shell scrapes.

lines.zh: 这里太干了，我喉咙发紧。
lines.en: Too dry here. My throat tightens.
I lift a foreleg and put it down again.
The sea is that way. I know the direction.
You're standing even tenser than I am.
I won't spit at you. For now.

lines.zh: 你站得太干，我不太习惯。
lines.en: You stand too dry; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 我低不下头，只能斜着看你。
lines.en: I can't lower my head, so I look at you sideways.

lines.zh: 你走近，我的毛就竖起来。
lines.en: As you come near, my wool bristles.

lines.zh: 这里是海的地方，你该回去了。
lines.en: This is the sea's ground. You should go back.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在头两侧，看得见你两次。
lines.en: My eyes sit on both sides; I see you twice.

lines.zh: 你要摸我，我先吐你一口。
lines.en: Touch me and I'll spit first.

lines.zh: 我歪着脖子，像在打量货物。
lines.en: I cock my neck as if sizing up goods.
The sea will come for me. Wait and see.

lines.zh: 我发出的声音，像漏气的鳃。
lines.en: The sound I make is like a leaking gill.
My wet wool makes the pain worse.
I back off and pull my neck in.
That left a mark on my shell.

lines.zh: 我吐出的不是唾沫，是海。
lines.en: What I spit isn't saliva — it's the sea.
My mouth is all blood taste.

lines.zh: 我站不稳，四条腿都在抖。
lines.en: I can't stand steady; all four legs tremble.

lines.zh: 羊驼的腿一软，我跪了一下。
lines.en: This llama's legs buckle and I kneel.
I retreat toward the shore.
The sea will know.
That bundle of grass in your hand is wet.
My neck reaches; the shadow arrives first.
Put it down. I'll get it myself.
There's a fishy note in that smell.
I take a bite and taste salt.

lines.zh: 你退后，我不喜欢人挨着。
lines.en: Step back. I don't like people close.
I'll eat the mud on the roots too.
A little more and I won't spit at you.

lines.zh: 我嚼得很慢，脖子一上一下。
lines.en: I chew slowly, my neck bobbing.
That's enough. Stop holding it up.
You hit the shell on my chest.

lines.zh: 我退开，水从毛里挤出来。
lines.en: I step back and water squeezes from my wool.
Now there's salt on your hands.

lines.zh: 我不喜欢被碰，尤其是后面。
lines.en: I don't like being touched, especially from behind.

lines.zh: 我们撞了一下，我抬起了头。
lines.en: We bumped and I raised my head.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子在你脚边停住。
lines.en: My hoof stops by your foot.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，壳刮了你一下。
lines.en: I turn aside and my shell scrapes you.
I've left a hollow in the ground here.
Afterward I shake my neck.
Don't come closer. I have something in my mouth.
The llamas don't recognize me.
I come near and they all back away.
I remember how to walk side by side.

lines.zh: 可我的脖子变了，靠不上去。
lines.en: But my neck has changed; I can't rest it on theirs.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子碰了碰它的鼻子。
lines.en: I touch my nose to its nose.
It smells the sea and runs off.
I stand there and don't follow.
They'll watch me from the shore.

lines.zh: 我不怪它们，我确实变了。
lines.en: I don't blame them. I have changed.
Maybe there's something else out past the sea.
A llama's teeth chew slowly.
This mouthful of grass is a little salty.
I eat the roots too.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我用嘴拱起来。
lines.en: I nudge what's on the ground up with my snout.
This one takes a long time to chew.

lines.zh: 我把嘴里的东西吐了出来。
lines.en: I spat out what was in my mouth.
Too hard. I can't bite through it.
I carry it in my mouth and walk off.
Afterward I lick my lips.
That salt taste is still there.
Someone's moving over by the village.
I straighten my neck.
That isn't a llama.
I fix on it, slowly.
The water in my mouth is ready.
It's a dozen paces from me.
I stay still and let it relax.
It's turning this way.
My ears point forward.
Just wait until it comes a little closer.
I follow at an angle without moving my neck.

lines.zh: 它每走一步，我就挪半步。
lines.en: Every step it takes, I take half a step.

lines.zh: 我在等一个正面的角度。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a clear angle.
The water in my mouth is getting hot.
It glances at me and doesn't care.
From this angle I can spit true.
I raise my head as high as it goes.
I've noted its position.
The tide is rising; the path will narrow.
Then it won't have anywhere to run.
I spit a mouthful and hit clean.
I lower my head and charge, shell first.

lines.zh: 这一吐，带上了海的东西。
lines.en: That spit carried something of the sea.

lines.zh: 我前蹄踏下去，沙飞起来。
lines.en: My forehooves stamp and the sand flies.
It dodges and I miss by half a step.
Another spit, and further this time.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的脖子，我甩开。
lines.en: It grabs my neck and I shake it off.
My shell cracks against its ribs.
It retreats. I stay where I am.
My mouth is dry; I need water.

lines.zh: 我从浪里走出来，四条腿都湿。
lines.en: I walk out of the surf, all four legs wet.
The shell on my neck is still growing.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖毛，水甩了一地。
lines.en: I shake my wool and water flies everywhere.
This doesn't look like the shore.
I raise my head and sniff the wind.
I remember being a llama.
I remember the pasture, and a bell.
Now I only want to go back into the water.
I walk slowly, hooves sinking in sand.

lines.zh: 远处有村子，我朝那边去。
lines.en: A village in the distance. I head that way.

lines.zh: 海嗣化的毛，烧出一股咸焦味。
lines.en: My seaborn fleece burns with a salty scorch.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，壳撞得响。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and my shell clangs.

lines.zh: 水没到我的鼻子，我抬不起头。
lines.en: Water reaches my nose and I can't lift my head.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，把我掀到水里。
lines.en: A blast throws me into the water.

lines.zh: 箭扎进颈侧，我吐出一口海水。
lines.en: An arrow hits my neck and I spit out seawater.

lines.zh: 一股冷劲顺着脖子下去，我直抖。
lines.en: A cold thread runs down my neck and I shiver.

lines.zh: 岸上的草都咸了，我吃不下。
lines.en: The grass on shore is all salt. I can't eat it.

lines.zh: 雷打在我的壳上，我整身都麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and numbs me through.
No water here, and no ground.
